newsitem.title: USA: ABC Rail backs FY97 $0.52 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: ABC Rail backs FY97 $0.52 EPS view.

text.p: ABC Rail Products Corp said Tuesday that it is comfortable with analysts' estimates calling for earnings of $0.52 a share for the fiscal year ending in July, down from $1.03 it earned a year ago.

"We're comfortable with $0.52, now," Donald Grinter, chief executive of the Chicago-based railroad equipment manufacturer. "That reflects all the changes we're doing and the costs associated with (them)."
The costs are associated with installing a new sanding system at its Calera wheel plant, he said, following a presentation at the Piper Jaffray investment conference here.

Grinter said that the Calera wheel plant would be back up to its spring 1996 capacity by the first quarter of 1998, after production was curtailed due to a fire in the spring of 1996 and the switch to the new sanding sytem.
"I'd say by first quarter of calendar year '98, we'll be back up to producing at our pre-fire capacity," Grinter said.

Grinter also said that ABC Rail's joint venture with the Chinese government will start producing wheels in the first quarter of calendar year 1998 and will reach 160,000-wheel capacity by the third quarter of 1998.

"We will start producing in the first quarter of 1998 with a 160,000-wheel capacity in the initial stage, which may be ratcheted up by 100,000 wheels later on," he said. "We'll reach the 160,000 wheel capacity in the third quarter of calendar year '98. However, given the demand for wheels, that could be moved up."
The joint venture was signed in the fiscal 1996 third quarter. ABC Rail holds a 40 percent interest in the joint venture.
ABC Rail shares were up 1/8 at 16-1/2 Tuesday.
